faqs.q: How much does a bathroom remodel cost in Boulder, CO?
faqs.a: Bathroom remodels in Boulder typically range from $10,000 to $35,000. Boulder's premium labor market puts costs 15–20% above national averages. A mid-range remodel runs $15,000–$22,000. We provide free in-home estimates.

faqs.q: How long does a bathroom remodel take in Boulder?
faqs.a: Most bathroom remodels take 2–4 weeks. Simple cosmetic updates can finish in 1–2 weeks, while full renovations including plumbing and tile work typically take 3–5 weeks.

faqs.q: Do you offer eco-friendly or sustainable bathroom remodeling?
faqs.a: Yes — we offer low-VOC materials, water-efficient fixtures, recycled tile options, and sustainable wood vanities. Boulder's environmental standards are built into our default material selections.

faqs.q: Do you handle permits with the City of Boulder?
faqs.a: Yes — we manage all City of Boulder building permits for your remodel. Boulder has specific requirements for plumbing and electrical work that our licensed contractors meet.

faqs.q: Do you serve Longmont, Broomfield, and Louisville?
faqs.a: Yes — we serve all of Boulder County including Longmont, Broomfield, Louisville, Lafayette, Superior, Erie, and surrounding communities.
